title: Stop Saying "Very Tired"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very tired". Say one of these instead:
• Exhausted: I'm exhausted!
• Drained: I felt drained after the exam.
• Worn out: I was worn out by Friday.
• The idiom: I'm dead on my feet!
